findings.title: Brief Builder Integration Not Implemented
findings.requirement: Stage 5 specification: 'Use this direction must populate the existing brief builder. The brand reviews the brief before saving or publishing.'
findings.issue: StageEvidence allows creator selection but provides no action to create a brief with the selected direction. The linked_brief_id field exists but is never populated. Workflow dead-ends after creator selection with no path to the existing proposal/agreement workflow.
findings.userImpact: Brand completes idea → directions → creator selection but cannot proceed to hire the creator. The existing proposal/agreement workflow is unreachable from Decision Room.
findings.correction: Add 'Create Brief with This Direction' button that: (1) Serializes room.requirements + room.selected_direction to sessionStorage or query params, (2) Navigates to /briefs/new?from=decision-room, (3) Pre-fills brief form fields, (4) After brief save, updates decision_rooms.linked_brief_id via PATCH /api/decision-room/[id]. Pattern exists in CineGenDirector.tsx:519,1177 using sessionStorage.

findings.title: Missing TypeScript Type Definitions
findings.requirement: All new types defined in types/index.ts
findings.issue: media-inspector.ts imports InspectionResult and InspectionCheck from @/types but these types are not defined in types/index.ts. Verified with grep: no matches found.
findings.userImpact: Violates project TypeScript conventions. Types are only used internally so build passes, but creates maintenance debt and violates stated requirement.
findings.correction: Add to types/index.ts: export interface InspectionCheck { requirement: string; actual: string; expected: string; passed: boolean; } and export interface InspectionResult { status: 'pass' | 'fail' | 'unsupported' | 'error'; checks: InspectionCheck[]; metadata: Record<string, any>; message?: string; }

findings.title: Keyboard Accessibility Not Implemented
findings.requirement: Keyboard operation, visible focus and reduced-motion support
findings.issue: Commit message claims 'Keyboard accessible (Tab, Enter, Escape)' but no keyboard event handlers exist. Verified with grep onKeyDown|onKeyPress: no results in decision-room components. Accordion stages cannot be toggled with Enter/Space, no Escape handler to close expanded sections.
findings.userImpact: Users relying on keyboard navigation cannot operate the Decision Room. Fails WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard accessible).
findings.correction: Add onKeyDown handlers to accordion buttons in DecisionRoomClient.tsx that respond to Enter/Space keys. Add top-level Escape handler to collapse expanded stage. Example: onKeyDown={(e) => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); toggleStage(stage.key); }}}

findings.title: Reduced-Motion Support Not Implemented
findings.location: All components using framer-motion in components/decision-room/
findings.requirement: Keyboard operation, visible focus and reduced-motion support
findings.issue: Commit message claims reduced-motion support but all framer-motion animations ignore prefers-reduced-motion media query. No checks for window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)') in any component.
findings.userImpact: Users with vestibular disorders or motion sensitivity preferences will experience animations despite OS-level setting. Fails WCAG 2.3.3 (Animation from Interactions).
findings.correction: Add useReducedMotion hook or inline checks before animations. Example: const prefersReducedMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches; Then conditionally disable animations: initial={prefersReducedMotion ? {} : { opacity: 0, y: 20 }}
